up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for the target CHEMBL1772932 (Mitotic checkpoint serine/threonine-protein kinase BUB1). The target is a human single-protein. Only include rows where the standard type is 'IC50', the standard relation is '=', and the pChEMBL value is not null. Return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
WITH target_info AS (
  SELECT tid, target_type, tax_id
  FROM target_dictionary
  WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1772932'
)
SELECT
  a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value
FROM activities act
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_info td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
